decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 5 - All proposed roof lights shall be of the conservation area type, flush-fitting with the roof tiles of the building.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0900 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday  and none shall take place on Saturdays or Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse (Strand on the Green Conservation Area)
